chen_2023_foods_xoi.title: Xanthine oxidase inhibitory peptides from Larimichthys polyactis: characterization and in vitro/in silico evidence (Chen X et al. 2023)
chen_2023_foods_xoi.terms: Full text read: small yellow croaker from Zhejiang Xianghai Food Co. (Wenzhou); peptides identified by nano-HPLC-MS/MS and chemically synthesised (purity > 95%); bovine-milk XO, xanthine, uric acid at 290 nm; IC50 3.16 +/- 0.03 mM and 5.86 +/- 0.02 mM in the text.
